source_handling: Preserved in the original version-controlled source checkout; embedded notebook/bootstrap commands were inspected, not executed.
deployment_scope: Isolated local canary; remote ServerSpace operating configuration remains unverified.

readiness_bits.1: canonical state and every canary cached dataset pass SHA256 and CRC32 checks
readiness_bits.2: canonical and shared state readback under exclusive writer lock
readiness_bits.4: signed peer request admitted over same-UID UDS

frame_validation_scope: Bounded observed IPC and loopback TCP runs; does not guarantee loss-free delivery on arbitrary networks.
paths: Canary state, mmap, UDS, keys and locks reside in the selected secured ServerSpace runtime directory.
non_merging: Equal unity values do not merge independently identified domain contexts.
